test_databricks_completion_sync: test the litellm completion call against Databricks using a sync HTTP handler with mocked responses
test_databricks_completion_async: test the litellm async completion call against Databricks using an async HTTP handler with mocked responses
test_databricks_completion_streaming: test the litellm streaming completion call against Databricks with both sync and async HTTP handlers
test_databricks_embeddings: test the litellm embedding call against Databricks with instruction parameters in sync and async modes
test_databricks_prompt_caching: test the litellm completion with Anthropic prompt caching including cache creation and cache read token tracking
